description: Burn everything - a fire caster who stacks dots and detonates them.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 36 real CoA Incineration talents (role DPS). Pyromancer measured 84.1% scalar-only, worst of the 13 classes remaining. IT IS ALSO THE BEST-STRUCTURED CLASS IN THE AUDIT: each tree owns exactly three talent-gated abilities at tiers 4, 5 and 6, nine in total with no strays - preserved exactly and asserted in main(). Heat and Embers do not exist (Pyromancer's resource is MANA with no secondary and no ability generates either), and nothing counts periodic effects on a target, which between them reshape eleven talents. spell_penetration IS live and becomes stronger once per-school creature resistances are authored.

nodes.name: Lighting the Fuse
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 15% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Allows your periodic effects to critically strike and increases your spell critical strike rating by 15% of your Intellect.' The conversion PORTS EXACTLY - crit_chance_spell is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and intellect in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES. The first half is dropped: there is no per-ability or per-effect 'can crit' flag, because everything can crit here already - the same non-issue as Venomancer Vizier's Fangbinder.

nodes.name: Magnitude 10
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Flare Bolt by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Flare Bolt by 5%.' Doubled for the two ranks. Flare Bolt is the spec's filler nuke. ability_*_crit is a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Searing Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Flare Bolt by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Flare Bolt by 20%.' There is no key for how much an ability scales with spell power - the coefficients live on the ability - so it is expressed as damage, which is what the scaling buys.

nodes.name: Embrace the Fire
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Blaze and Ignite by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Blaze and Ignite by 20%.' Both abilities exist in Frontier and are the spec's two dots - what CoA calls its 'Pyromancer periodic effects', which three other talents try to count.

nodes.name: Arsonist
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Standardised 6 Nov: every caster tree carries one 5-point spell-crit-damage talent worth +100% at full rank, matching priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury (both WoW-accurate). Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.'

nodes.name: Cataclysmic Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Flare Bolt by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA over 3 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Flare Bolt by 3% for each periodic effect you have on the target.' NOTHING COUNTS EFFECTS ON A TARGET - no effect key reads a target's debuffs at all - so the per-dot scaling cannot exist. This spec maintains three periodic effects in practice (Ignite, Blaze and whichever Scorch is up), so 3% x 3 dots is 9% per rank, reaching 27% at full investment. Authored at the PER-RANK value with CoA's own 3 ranks, so the policy skips it and get_effective_effects() multiplies by points spent.

nodes.name: Combustion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Explode by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Explode is now increased by 15% for each of your Pyromancer periodic effects on the target.' Same wall as Cataclysmic Power - nothing counts effects on a target - so 15% x 3 realistic dots is 45%, flat. Explode is the spec's detonator and the whole point of stacking dots, so this is the node that most wants the real mechanic and cannot have it.

nodes.name: Scorched
nodes.description: Your critical strikes scorch the target, burning them for fire damage over 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive: 'Direct critical strikes with Ember spenders now Scorch the target, Burning them for an additional 30% of the damage dealt over 6 sec.' on_crit is live and a dot is the right shape, so this ports closely - 6 sec is 2 turns. The Ember-spender scoping is dropped (no such membership) so it fires on any crit, and the potency is flat because an apply_effect payload cannot read the triggering hit's damage.

nodes.name: Melting Point
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 3%, and your critical strikes leave the target taking 3% more spell damage for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 3% and critical strikes with Fire spells now increases the chance for the enemy to by critically hit with spells by 3% for 12 seconds.' THERE IS NO RECIPIENT-SIDE 'CHANCE TO BE CRIT' KEY - crit lives on the attacker - so it becomes spell damage taken at CoA's own 3%, the same translation used four times already in this audit. 12 sec is 4 turns. No trigger-side school filter exists, so 'with Fire spells' is dropped; this spec casts almost nothing else.

nodes.name: Explosive
nodes.description: Increases the damage your damage-over-time spells deal by 21%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the tick rate of Blaze and Ignite by 10%.' A faster tick has no meaning when ticks are per-turn, so the doubled 20% becomes dot damage - what a faster tick delivers.

nodes.name: Wreath of Flames
nodes.description: Your spells have a 10% chance to set you flamecasting, raising your haste by 5% per stack for 5 turns, stacking 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Periodic Fire damage now has a 10% chance to grant a stack of Flamecasting, or 2 stacks if they critically strike. Increases your spell haste by 5% for 15 sec. Stacks 5 times. Additional applications do not refresh duration.' Periodic damage has no trigger, so it fires off casts. CoA's 10%, 5% and 5 stacks all kept; 15 sec is 5 turns. A payload cannot grant two stacks at once, so the crit bonus is dropped, and re-application always refreshes here. Frontier has no Wreath of Flames ABILITY, so this is purely the talent.

nodes.name: Flames of Focus
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Adds 1 additional stack to Flamecasting and increases its duration by 5 sec.' NO KEY MODIFIES ANOTHER EFFECT'S max_stacks OR DURATION - the same wall that took Venomancer Fortitude's Beetle Poison - so neither half is buildable. Granted as flat haste, which is what a sixth Flamecasting stack would have been worth.

nodes.name: To Ashes
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore mana.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damaging critical strikes now generate 10 Heat and restore 3% of your base mana.' Heat does not exist. The mana half ports in shape, but grant_resource takes a FLAT `amount` only - no percentage-of-maximum form - so 40 stands in for 3% of a mid-level pool. 1-turn internal cooldown so a multi-hit turn does not refill the bar.

nodes.name: Pyromaniac
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Explode, Flames of Neltharion and Lava Shard by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Ember spenders by 5%.' Embers do not exist, so CoA's 'Ember spenders' is read as the three big direct nukes Frontier has - Explode, Flames of Neltharion and Lava Shard - which are what the term covers in CoA's own tooltips. CoA's 5% kept.

nodes.name: Pyromantic Accelerants
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Flames of Neltharion and Explode by 9%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Flames of Neltharion and Explode now deal 15% increased damage to Burning targets.' No effect key reads whether a target carries a debuff, and this spec keeps everything Burning anyway, so the condition was nearly always true. CoA's 15% kept and applies always.

nodes.name: Fiery Passion
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, your spell haste is increased by 3%.' A TALENT CANNOT REACH AN ALLY - get_talent_effects() reads only the character's own trees - so the party half lands on the Pyromancer too, giving CoA's two 3% halves as a single 6%. The description says 'your' rather than promising a raid buff the engine will not deliver.

nodes.name: Rapid Incineration
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Lava Shard and Pillar of Flame by 21%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Consuming Embers now reduces the cooldown of Lava Shard and Pillar of Flame by 10%.' Embers do not exist, so the trigger condition goes and the reduction is permanent, doubled to 20% since it no longer needs a spender to fire. POSITIVE reduces. Pillar of Flame is unlocked at tier 4 below, so this node is worth taking after it.

nodes.name: Sizzle
nodes.description: Your damage-over-time spells throw off a Flare Bolt.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'When Flamecasting expires you launch a Flare Bolt on up to 12 enemies affected by your active Pyromancer periodic effects.' NO TRIGGER FIRES WHEN AN EFFECT EXPIRES, and nothing selects targets by which debuffs they carry. Rebuilt so the dots themselves throw the bolt - cast_ability takes a bare id and Flare Bolt is auto-learned, so it is in the book. 25% with a 1-turn icd rather than guaranteed, since a free nuke on every dot cast would outclass the rotation.

nodes.name: Pillar of Flame
nodes.description: Teaches Pillar of Flame, a lava pillar that also burns nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Generates 20 Heat Per Target. Create a pillar of lava beneath an enemy, dealing Fire damage. Deals an additional Fire damage to enemies near the primary target.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: pyromancer_pillar_of_flame carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. Kept at tier 4 exactly where the shipped tree had it - Pyromancer's three trees each own three gated abilities at tiers 4, 5 and 6, the best-structured arrangement in this audit, and moving one would break that pattern and every existing build.

nodes.name: Incinerator
nodes.description: Increases your spell penetration by 30.
nodes._source: CoA's level 40 passive: 'Increases your spell penetration by 30, scaling with your level.' PORTS AS WRITTEN, minus the level scaling (no key scales a flat rating by level). `spell_penetration` is fed from bonuses into a real character attribute (character.py:1382) and read attacker-side by BOTH Character.take_damage and Monster.take_damage, so it genuinely works today against magic resistance - and it becomes a much stronger node whenever per-school creature resistances get authored, which is currently shelved. A FLAT RATING, not a percentage.

nodes.name: Roasted Alive
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Fired Up! by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the chance to trigger Fired Up by 20%.' Fired Up is an ABILITY with a cooldown here, not a proc, so there is no trigger chance to increase. Rerouted to its cooldown, which is the same outcome - Fired Up available more often. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Flamespiller
nodes.description: Your critical strikes with Explode or Flames of Neltharion burst for fire damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes with Explode or Flames of Neltharion now extend the duration of Fired Up by 0.5 sec.' NO PAYLOAD EXTENDS A LIVE EFFECT'S DURATION, and half a second is below a turn regardless. Rerouted to direct damage off exactly CoA's two abilities, so the node still rewards critting with them. 1-turn internal cooldown.

nodes.name: Fired Up!
nodes.description: Teaches Fired Up!, a burst window that sharply raises your critical strike chance.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Ember spenders are now instant and have a 30% chance to refund their cost and increases your chance to critically strike by 30% for 15 sec.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: pyromancer_fired_up carries requires_talent. The instant-cast and cost-refund halves live on the ability or not at all; the talent only grants it. Kept at tier 5 where the shipped tree had it.

nodes.name: Residual Power
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of Explode, Flames of Neltharion and Lava Shard by 21%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Each active Ember now reduces the cast time of Explode by -8%.' Embers do not exist and there are no cast times, so nothing of this talent survives as written. Rerouted to the cost of the three spenders, which is what cheaper, faster Ember spending bought.

nodes.name: Magmatic
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA's own description for this node is the unresolved token '$8a' - the Builder payload never expands it - so there is no verbatim text to port and this is NOT a faithful copy. Named from CoA's own title and built as flat damage. Flagged so a later pass can correct it if the real text surfaces; the same situation as Brewing's Mixologist ('$40'), Lightning's Umbral Glaive ('$42'), Wind's Tempest Calling ('$4c') and Venom's Rot Lich ('$b2').

nodes.name: Pyroclasm
nodes.description: Teaches Pyroclasm, and your damage-over-time spells deal 30% more.
nodes._source: LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: pyromancer_pyroclasm carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. Kept at tier 6 as the shipped tree had it, completing Pyromancer's 4/5/6 gated-ability pattern. The dot damage is added because a capstone that only grants an ability is thin - the ability carries its own tooltip, and this way the node also pays off every dot the tree has been stacking. A capstone granting an ability AND a real effect is the shape used on Lightning's Ride the Lightning too.
